How to Install WoW Addons (2025 Guide for Beginners)

## Difference Between Add-ons and Weakauras

An addon in TBC Anniversary is a full-featured UI modification that adds new systems or replaces parts of the game interface, such as damage meters, boss mods, action bars, or inventory management.
Addons are installed as separate folders, run continuously, and usually provide their own settings menus and long-term functionality.

A WeakAura, on the other hand, is a lightweight, highly customizable visual or audio trigger created inside the WeakAuras addon. WeakAuras are used to track very specific things like a cooldown, buff, debuff, proc, or resource, and show alerts only when certain conditions are met. In short, addons change how the game works overall, while WeakAuras give you precise, situation-based alerts on top of that.

To start using Weakauras, simply install the main addon, and then copy the import string from the aura you found interesting into the import section of the addon.

## The Burning Crusade Anniversary Best Addons FAQ

Add-ons improve your interface and track important info like buffs, debuffs, cooldowns, quests, and resources.

### What is the Difference between Add-ons and WeakAuras in TBC Anniversary?

Add-ons are standalone modifications that run on their own, while WeakAuras are created within the WeakAuras addon and depend on it to work.

### How Do I Install Add-ons in TBC Classic Anniversary?

You can use an addon manager like CurseForge or WowUp for easy installation and updates. You can also install manually by placing the addon folder in \_classic\_era\_/Interface/AddOns and restarting the game.

### Will Add-ons Affect My Account in TBC Classic Anniversary?

Addons are safe and widely used in TBC Anniversary. They don’t modify game mechanics, so they won’t get you banned.

Whether you're leveling your first character, preparing for Karazhan, or looking to optimize gold-making routes, addons play a massive role in improving quality of life. While the core gameplay remains faithful to The Burning Crusade, modern addon support makes the experience smoother, more efficient, and far less frustrating than it was back in the day, especially if you're aiming to maximize efficiency or farm WoW TBC Classic Anniversary Gold.

Best WoW TBC Anniversary Addons and How to Set Them Up

That said, installing addons on the Anniversary servers hasn't been completely intuitive for everyone. Some players have encountered missing folders or incomplete support at launch. The good news is that once you understand the setup process, managing addons becomes just as easy as it is on other versions of WoW.

**How to Get and Install WoW TBC Anniversary Addons**

The simplest and most reliable way to install addons for WoW TBC Anniversary is through CurseForge.
It remains the most popular addon manager and supports the majority of Classic-era addons. However, at launch, some players noticed that there wasn't a clearly labeled "TBC Anniversary" option in the CurseForge dropdown menu.

If CurseForge doesn't automatically detect your Anniversary client, don't worry, there's a quick workaround that solves the issue:

Navigate to your World of Warcraft installation folder on your PC.

Open the Classic or Classic Era directory.

Copy an existing addon folder (for example, Questie or Details!).

Paste it into your Anniversary > Interface > AddOns folder.

Restart CurseForge and refresh the game dropdown.

After doing this, CurseForge should recognize WoW TBC Anniversary as a supported version. Once it does, you'll be able to browse, install, and update addons normally. Keep in mind that some addons may still be unstable or missing features early on, as developers continue pushing updates.
